verdict.rationale: WorkOS explicitly documents M2M applications via client-credentials-style flows ('M2M applications are commonly used to provide API access credentials to customers or partners, allowing them to programmatically access your APIs') and supports OAuth applications built-in, plus a spec-compliant OAuth authorization server (AuthKit) that gates its MCP server behind OAuth, confirmed live via probe. This directly enables backend services/agents to authenticate without human interaction. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of the M2M client-credentials flow itself (only docs cited), and no explicit token-lifetime/scoping details for agent-specific machine credentials.
